Draw inspection samples from the labeled Schedule N table

Source: R/inspect.R
sn_inspection.Rd

Samples labeled filings, stratified by classifier label, and returns every row of each sampled filing. With num greater than 1, the tables do not share filings, so they can go to different reviewers.

Usage

sn_inspection(
  x,
  num = 1L,
  n = 100L,
  types = NULL,
  per_type = NULL,
  seed = 1L,
  review_cols = TRUE
)

Arguments

x

A table from sn_labeled().

num

Number of inspection tables.

n

Filings (cases) per table.

types

Labels to sample. Default: every label in x.

per_type

Optional named integer vector of filings per label in each table (overrides the even split of n).

seed

Random seed, or NULL to leave the seed alone.

review_cols

Add empty review columns (REVIEW_TYPE, REVIEW_IS_MERGER, REVIEW_RECIPIENT_OK, REVIEW_NOTE).

Value

A list of num data.tables. Each has TABLE and CASE (1..n) in front of the sn_labeled() columns, sorted by label, case, part, and line.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
sn <- get_schedule_n( efile_years() )
md <- build_merger_data( sn = sn )

lab <-
  sn_labeled(
    sn,
    md$sched_n,
    md$cases,
    md$transactions
  )

# three stratified samples of 100 filings each
tabs <- sn_inspection( lab, num = 3, n = 100 )

data.table::fwrite( tabs[[1]], "inspection-01.csv" )
} # }
